examples.src: The senseless violence shocked everyone.
examples.dst: 这场毫无意义的暴力令所有人震惊。

confuse.diff: hospital指医院,规模更大;clinic指诊所

examples.dst: 我们绕道走以避开拥堵。

examples.dst: 我们坐在一棵树荫下。

examples.dst: 他卷入了一些可疑的生意交易。

examples.dst: 小路凉爽而阴凉。

confuse.diff: shade 是名词，阴凉处；shady 是形容词

examples.src: She is a diligent student who always finishes her homework.
examples.dst: 她是个勤奋的学生,总是完成作业。

examples.src: Diligent research led to an important discovery.
examples.dst: 勤勉的研究促成了一项重要发现。

examples.dst: 他因鲁莽驾驶被罚款。

examples.dst: 儿童心理学帮助父母理解孩子。

examples.dst: 这本书讲解了青少年的心理。

confuse.diff: psychiatry是精神病学,侧重治疗;psychology是心理学

examples.src: We drove along the motorway for two hours.

examples.src: The teacher rebuked him for being late.

examples.dst: 她被演艺圈的光鲜魅力所吸引。

examples.dst: 嘘，宝宝在睡觉。

examples.dst: 她让孩子们安静下来，开始讲故事。

examples.dst: 人群突然安静了下来。

confuse.diff: hush 指安静；hash 指杂烩或井号符号。

examples.src: The dog wagged its tail happily.
examples.dst: 狗高兴地摇着尾巴。

examples.dst: 她对着淘气的男孩摇了摇手指。

unacceptable 指不可接受的，inaccessible 指难以到达的

examples.dst: 对环境造成的破坏可能是不可逆的。

examples.dst: 文件一旦删除，这个操作就无法撤销。

examples.dst: 这种疾病会导致大脑发生不可逆的变化。

confuse.diff: irrevocable 强调不可撤回，多用于决定或法律；irreversible 强调过程无法逆转

examples.src: The inn offers good, homely food.
examples.dst: 这家旅店提供美味的家常饭菜。

examples.dst: 我们喜欢小屋里温馨的家庭气氛。

examples.dst: 在美式英语中，homely 常指相貌平平。

examples.src: The premier gave a speech on television.
examples.dst: 总理在电视上发表了讲话。

examples.src: This is the premier university in the country.
examples.dst: 这是全国首屈一指的大学。

examples.src: The premier met the foreign minister yesterday.
examples.dst: 总理昨天会见了外交部长。

confuse.diff: premiere是首映,premier是总理

examples.src: The plan is cheap; moreover, it is environmentally friendly.
examples.dst: 这个计划成本低,而且对环境友好。

examples.dst: 这个理论很简单,而且能很好地解释数据。

examples.src: Moreover, the results have been confirmed by other studies.
examples.dst: 此外,这些结果已被其他研究证实。

examples.src: The truck is lifted by a hydraulic jack.
examples.dst: 这辆卡车由液压千斤顶抬起。

examples.src: Hydraulic brakes use fluid to transmit force.
examples.dst: 液压制动器利用液体传递力。

examples.dst: 工程师为起重机设计了一套液压系统。

examples.src: Untreated water may contain harmful bacteria.
examples.dst: 未经处理的水可能含有有害细菌。

examples.src: The infection can be serious if left untreated.
examples.dst: 感染如果不治疗，可能会很严重。

examples.dst: 未经处理的污水被排入了河中。

examples.src: Don't fret about the exam results.
examples.dst: 别为考试成绩烦恼。

examples.src: The baby fretted all night.
examples.dst: 婴儿整夜烦躁不安。

examples.dst: 酸雨侵蚀了石头的表面。

examples.src: Everyone is welcome, irrespective of age.
examples.dst: 无论年龄大小，人人都受欢迎。

examples.src: The law applies to all citizens irrespective of their background.
examples.dst: 这项法律适用于所有公民，不论出身如何。

examples.src: He did it irrespective of the consequences.
examples.dst: 他不顾后果地做了这件事。

confuse.diff: respective 指各自的，irrespective 指不考虑的
irrelevant 指不相关的，irrespective 常与 of 连用表示不论

examples.src: The manager had a haughty manner towards staff.
examples.dst: 经理对员工态度傲慢。

examples.src: She gave him a haughty look and walked away.
examples.dst: 她傲慢地看了他一眼就走开了。

examples.src: His haughty attitude made him unpopular.
examples.dst: 他高傲的态度让他不受欢迎。

confuse.diff: hearty 指热情的或丰盛的

examples.src: The panda reserve was set up in 1963.
examples.dst: 这个熊猫保护区建于1963年。

examples.src: I'd like to reserve a table for four.
examples.dst: 我想预订一张四人桌。

examples.src: The country has large oil reserves.
examples.dst: 这个国家有大量石油储备。

confuse.diff: reserve 意为预订、保留；deserve 意为应得。

examples.src: The whole country mourned the great leader.
examples.dst: 全国人民哀悼这位伟大的领袖。

examples.src: She still mourns for her lost friend.
examples.dst: 她仍在为失去的朋友悲痛。

examples.src: They mourned the death of the old teacher.
examples.dst: 他们哀悼那位老教师的逝世。

confuse.diff: morn是诗词中的早晨,mourn是哀悼

examples.src: Your Majesty, the guests have arrived.
examples.dst: 陛下,客人们已经到了。

examples.src: We were amazed by the majesty of the mountains.
examples.dst: 我们为群山的雄伟而惊叹。

examples.src: The queen walked with great majesty.
examples.dst: 女王举止威严地走着。

confuse.diff: magic是魔法,majesty是威严或陛下

examples.dst: 同盟军发动了联合进攻。

examples.src: Medicine and allied professions need more workers.
examples.dst: 医学及相关行业需要更多人手。

examples.src: The two companies became allied against their rival.
examples.dst: 这两家公司联合起来对付竞争对手。

confuse.diff: alloyed 指合金的，allied 指结盟的
allude 指暗指，与 allied 词形相近但意思不同

examples.src: The company is known for its innovation.
examples.dst: 这家公司以创新闻名。

examples.dst: 技术创新推动经济增长。

examples.src: The touch screen was a major innovation.
examples.dst: 触摸屏是一项重大创新。

examples.src: We heard a shot in the distance.

examples.dst: 摄影师拍了一张美丽的日出照片。

examples.dst: 护士给他打了一针流感疫苗。

confuse.diff: shot 是射击、镜头；short 是短的。

examples.src: This medicine will relieve the pain.
examples.dst: 这种药可以缓解疼痛。

examples.src: New buses were added to relieve traffic congestion.
examples.dst: 增加了新的公交车以缓解交通拥堵。

examples.src: The winters here are mild.

examples.dst: 他在课本的页边做了批注。

means: 值得的；有价值的；应得的

examples.src: She is worthy of the prize.

examples.src: We must safeguard our children's future.
examples.dst: 我们必须保护孩子们的未来。

examples.src: Strict rules safeguard the privacy of patients.
examples.dst: 严格的规定保护患者的隐私。

examples.dst: 这座城市长期以来都是商业中心。

examples.dst: 她在大学里学的是商科。

examples.dst: 他心中涌起一阵怒气。

examples.dst: 令人眼花缭乱的变化速度让所有人吃惊。

examples.dst: 后面的章节讨论了战争的起因。

examples.src: There is a striking likeness between the two sisters.

examples.dst: 这幅肖像画得很像她。

examples.src: He noticed a likeness in their handwriting.

examples.src: The museum holds a series of lectures every month.

examples.dst: 结婚四十年后，他失去了伴侣。

examples.src: Young children are susceptible to infections.

examples.src: He wore a dark suit to the meeting.

examples.dst: 星期五你方便吗?

examples.dst: 飓风通常在温暖的海面上形成。

examples.src: The road was uneven and full of holes.

examples.dst: 他们改革了旧制度。

examples.dst: 出狱后，他改过自新，找到了一份好工作。

examples.src: The conference proceedings were published online.
examples.dst: 会议论文集已在网上发表。

examples.src: The proceedings were delayed by heavy rain.
examples.dst: 活动因大雨而推迟。

confuse.diff: procedure 是程序或步骤，proceeding 多指诉讼或活动的进行

examples.src: The library adjoins the science building.
examples.dst: 图书馆与科学楼相邻。

examples.src: The farm adjoins a large forest.
examples.dst: 这个农场毗邻一大片森林。

examples.src: We stayed in adjoining rooms.
examples.dst: 我们住在相邻的房间。

confuse.diff: adjourn 是休会，adjoin 是毗邻

examples.src: The farmer slaughtered two pigs for the feast.
examples.dst: 农夫为宴席宰了两头猪。

examples.src: The slaughter of innocent civilians shocked the world.
examples.dst: 对无辜平民的屠杀震惊了世界。

examples.src: Our team was slaughtered in the final.
examples.dst: 我们队在决赛中惨败。

confuse.diff: laughter 指笑声，slaughter 指屠杀

examples.src: The intricacy of the design amazed the visitors.
examples.dst: 设计的精巧复杂令参观者惊叹。

examples.src: Students struggled with the intricacies of the tax system.
examples.dst: 学生们难以理解税收制度的种种复杂细节。

examples.src: The intricacy of the plot makes the novel hard to follow.
examples.dst: 情节错综复杂，使这部小说难以读懂。

confuse.diff: intricate 是形容词复杂的，intricacy 是名词复杂性

examples.src: He applied for British citizenship.
examples.dst: 他申请了英国国籍。

examples.src: Good citizenship means obeying the law.
examples.dst: 良好的公民素养包括遵守法律。

examples.src: The school teaches students about citizenship.
examples.dst: 学校教学生了解公民责任。

confuse.diff: citizenship 指公民身份；citizen 指公民本人。

examples.src: The army suppressed the uprising.
examples.dst: 军队镇压了起义。

examples.src: She tried to suppress her laughter.
examples.dst: 她努力忍住笑。

examples.src: Certain drugs suppress the immune system.
examples.dst: 某些药物会抑制免疫系统。

confuse.diff: oppress 指压迫
repress 多指压抑情感

examples.src: Write a short summary of the story.
examples.dst: 写一篇这个故事的简短摘要。

examples.src: The report ends with a summary of the main points.
examples.dst: 报告以要点总结作结尾。

examples.src: Here is a summary of today's news.
examples.dst: 以下是今天的新闻摘要。

confuse.diff: summery 意为夏天的，夏季般的

examples.src: Polar bears live in places of extreme cold.
examples.dst: 北极熊生活在极度寒冷的地方。

examples.src: He went to extremes to win the competition.
examples.dst: 他为了赢得比赛不惜采取极端手段。

examples.src: Extreme sports require careful training and safety checks.
examples.dst: 极限运动需要严格的训练和安全检查。

confuse.diff: extreme 是形容词，指极端的；extremely 是副词，指极其。

examples.src: She was very discreet about her private life.
examples.dst: 她对自己的私生活非常谨慎。

examples.src: He made discreet inquiries about the job.
examples.dst: 他悄悄打听了这份工作的情况。

examples.src: A good assistant must be discreet with confidential information.
examples.dst: 好助理必须谨慎对待机密信息。

confuse.diff: discrete 指分离的、离散的，读音相同，discreet 指谨慎的

examples.src: The clinic is affiliated with the university.
examples.dst: 这家诊所隶属于该大学。

examples.src: He refused to affiliate himself with any political party.
examples.dst: 他拒绝加入任何政党。

examples.src: The local station is an affiliate of a national network.
examples.dst: 这家地方电视台是一个全国性电视网的附属台。

confuse.diff: affiliation 是名词，指隶属关系，affiliate 是动词

examples.src: She is an imaginative writer.
examples.dst: 她是个富有想象力的作家。

examples.src: The children made an imaginative drawing.
examples.dst: 孩子们画了一幅富有想象力的画。

examples.src: We need an imaginative solution.
examples.dst: 我们需要一个有创意的解决办法。

confuse.diff: imaginary 指想象出来的，imaginative 指有想象力的

examples.src: According to my calculations, the project costs ten thousand pounds.
examples.dst: 据我计算,这个项目要花一万英镑。

examples.src: The calculation was done by computer.
examples.dst: 这项计算是用计算机完成的。

examples.src: A small error in the calculation led to the wrong result.
examples.dst: 计算中的一个小错误导致了错误的结果。

confuse.diff: calculator 指计算器,calculation 指计算

examples.src: He has an inclination to talk too much.
examples.dst: 他有话多的倾向。

examples.src: She showed no inclination to leave.
examples.dst: 她没有表现出要离开的意思。

examples.src: The inclination of the roof is about thirty degrees.
examples.dst: 屋顶的倾斜度大约是三十度。

confuse.diff: inclination 是倾向或倾斜；declination 是偏角或下降。

examples.src: I unintentionally deleted the file.
examples.dst: 我无意中删除了那个文件。

examples.src: She unintentionally hurt his feelings.
examples.dst: 她无意间伤害了他的感情。

examples.src: The error was made unintentionally.
examples.dst: 这个错误是无意中造成的。

confuse.diff: unintentional 是形容词，unintentionally 是副词

examples.src: The conversion of the old factory into flats took two years.
examples.dst: 把旧工厂改建成公寓用了两年时间。

examples.src: Plants carry out the conversion of sunlight into energy.
examples.dst: 植物将阳光转化为能量。

examples.src: The website offers a currency conversion tool.
examples.dst: 该网站提供货币换算工具。

confuse.diff: conversion 是转变；conversation 是交谈。

examples.src: He bought health insurance last year.
examples.dst: 他去年买了健康保险。

examples.src: The insurance covers damage from fire.
examples.dst: 这份保险涵盖火灾造成的损失。

examples.src: Car insurance is required by law.
examples.dst: 法律规定必须购买车险。

confuse.diff: insurance 指保险；assurance 指保证、信心。

examples.src: The hostess welcomed the guests at the door.
examples.dst: 女主人在门口迎接客人。

examples.src: She thanked the hostess for the lovely dinner.
examples.dst: 她感谢女主人的美味晚餐。

examples.src: The hostess of the show is very popular.
examples.dst: 这档节目的女主持人很受欢迎。

confuse.diff: hostess 指女主人；host 指男主人或泛指主人。

examples.src: Prosecutors allege that he stole the money.
examples.dst: 检方指控他偷了这笔钱。

examples.src: The report alleges widespread corruption.
examples.dst: 报告声称存在普遍的腐败。

examples.src: She alleged that she had been treated unfairly.
examples.dst: 她声称自己受到了不公平待遇。

confuse.diff: alleviate 指减轻
allude 指暗指

examples.src: He carried the heavy box upstairs.
examples.dst: 他把重箱子搬上了楼。

examples.src: Can you carry my bag for me?
examples.dst: 你能帮我拿一下包吗？

examples.src: She carries a book everywhere.
examples.dst: 她走到哪儿都带着一本书。

confuse.diff: carry 是携带；carrot 是胡萝卜。

examples.src: She showed great initiative in solving the problem.
examples.dst: 她在解决问题时表现出很强的主动性。

examples.src: The government launched a new health initiative.
examples.dst: 政府推出了一项新的健康倡议。

examples.src: He took the initiative and contacted the client first.
examples.dst: 他主动先联系了客户。

confuse.diff: initial 是最初的，initiative 是主动性

examples.src: We watched a documentary about pandas.
examples.dst: 我们看了一部关于熊猫的纪录片。

examples.src: The documentary shows life in the Arctic.
examples.dst: 这部纪录片展示了北极的生活。

examples.src: She likes documentaries more than cartoons.
examples.dst: 比起卡通片,她更喜欢纪录片。

confuse.diff: document是文件,documentary是纪录片

examples.src: The union took a militant stand in the negotiations.
examples.dst: 工会在谈判中采取了强硬立场。

examples.src: Militants attacked the convoy at dawn.
examples.dst: 激进分子在黎明时袭击了车队。

examples.src: He became a militant campaigner for animal rights.
examples.dst: 他成为一名积极的动物权利斗士。

confuse.diff: military 指军事的，militant 指激进好斗的

examples.src: A washing machine is a useful household appliance.
examples.dst: 洗衣机是一种有用的家用电器。

examples.src: Modern kitchens are full of electrical appliances.
examples.dst: 现代厨房里满是电器。

examples.src: Unplug the appliance before cleaning it.
examples.dst: 清洁电器前请先拔掉插头。

confuse.diff: appliance 是器具；application 是申请、应用。

examples.src: Honesty is her most admirable trait.
examples.dst: 诚实是她最令人钦佩的品质。

examples.src: Eye colour is an inherited trait.
examples.dst: 眼睛的颜色是一种遗传特征。

examples.src: Patience is a useful trait for teachers.
examples.dst: 耐心是教师的一项有用特质。

confuse.diff: trail 是小径或痕迹，trait 是特征

examples.src: She felt sick during the early months of her pregnancy.
examples.dst: 怀孕的头几个月她一直感到恶心。

examples.src: Doctors advise women to avoid alcohol during pregnancy.
examples.dst: 医生建议女性孕期不要饮酒。

examples.src: The test confirmed her pregnancy.
examples.dst: 检查证实了她怀孕。

confuse.diff: pregnant 是形容词，怀孕的，pregnancy 是名词，怀孕

examples.src: The boiler broke down in the middle of winter.
examples.dst: 锅炉在隆冬时节坏了。

examples.src: We need to replace the old boiler in the basement.
examples.dst: 我们需要更换地下室里的旧锅炉。

examples.src: The factory's steam boiler supplies heat to the whole building.
examples.dst: 工厂的蒸汽锅炉为整栋楼供暖。

confuse.diff: boil 是动词，煮沸，boiler 是名词，锅炉

examples.src: The dog sniffed the ground to find the scent.
examples.dst: 狗嗅着地面寻找气味。

examples.src: She sniffed the flowers and smiled.
examples.dst: 她闻了闻花,笑了。

examples.src: The boy sniffed and wiped his nose.
examples.dst: 男孩吸了吸鼻子,擦了擦鼻涕。

confuse.diff: snuff指鼻烟,sniff指嗅

examples.src: The teacher praised the children for their good behavior.
examples.dst: 老师表扬孩子们表现良好。

examples.src: Scientists study animal behavior in the wild.
examples.dst: 科学家在野外研究动物的行为。

examples.src: His behavior at the party embarrassed everyone.
examples.dst: 他在聚会上的举止让大家很尴尬。

confuse.diff: behaviour 是英式拼写，behavior 是美式拼写
behave 是动词，指表现

examples.src: The lights turn on automatically at night.
examples.dst: 灯在夜里会自动亮起。

examples.src: He automatically reached for the phone.
examples.dst: 他不由自主地伸手去拿手机。

examples.src: The file is saved automatically every minute.
examples.dst: 文件每分钟自动保存一次。

confuse.diff: automatically 是副词；automatic 是形容词。

examples.src: She likes contemporary music and art.
examples.dst: 她喜欢当代音乐和艺术。

examples.src: Shakespeare and Marlowe were contemporaries.
examples.dst: 莎士比亚和马洛是同时代的人。

examples.src: The museum has a contemporary art section.
examples.dst: 博物馆设有当代艺术展区。

confuse.diff: contemporary 指当代的；temporary 指暂时的。

examples.src: Love is an abstract idea that is hard to define.
examples.dst: 爱是一个很难定义的抽象概念。

examples.src: She likes abstract paintings with bright colours.
examples.dst: 她喜欢色彩鲜艳的抽象画。

examples.src: Please read the abstract before the whole paper.
examples.dst: 请在读全文之前先读摘要。

confuse.diff: abstract 指抽象的；absorb 指吸收。

examples.src: A swarm of locusts destroyed the crops.
examples.dst: 一群蝗虫毁掉了庄稼。

examples.src: Locusts can travel hundreds of kilometres in search of food.
examples.dst: 蝗虫为觅食可以飞行数百公里。

examples.src: The farmers feared a locust plague.
examples.dst: 农民们害怕蝗灾。

confuse.diff: locust 是蝗虫；lotus 是莲花。

examples.src: Children are afraid of the monster under the bed.
examples.dst: 孩子们害怕床底下的怪物。

examples.src: The film is about a sea monster.
examples.dst: 这部电影讲的是一只海怪。

examples.src: The dictator was seen as a monster by his people.
examples.dst: 这位独裁者被他的人民视为恶魔。

confuse.diff: monstrous 是形容词，怪异的或可怕的，monster 是名词

examples.src: Always make a backup of your important files.
examples.dst: 一定要为重要文件做备份。

examples.src: The police called for backup.
examples.dst: 警方请求增援。

examples.src: We keep a backup generator in case of power cuts.
examples.dst: 我们备有备用发电机以防停电。

confuse.diff: back up 是动词短语，表示备份或支持，backup 是名词或形容词

examples.src: She spoke with great confidence.
examples.dst: 她充满自信地讲话。

examples.src: I have full confidence in my team.
examples.dst: 我对我的团队充满信心。

examples.src: Practice will give you confidence.
examples.dst: 练习会给你带来自信。

confuse.diff: confident 是形容词，意为自信的
confidential 意为机密的

examples.src: We bought the sofa in monthly installments.
examples.dst: 我们按月分期付款买了这张沙发。

examples.src: The final installment is due next week.
examples.dst: 最后一期款项下周到期。

examples.src: The second installment of the series will air tonight.
examples.dst: 这个系列的第二集今晚播出。

confuse.diff: installation 指安装，installment 指分期付款
instalment 是英式拼写，意思相同

examples.src: He confessed that he had broken the window.
examples.dst: 他承认窗户是他打破的。

examples.src: The suspect confessed to the robbery.
examples.dst: 嫌疑人供认了抢劫罪行。

examples.src: I must confess that I don't understand the question.
examples.dst: 我必须承认我没明白这个问题。

confuse.diff: confuse 指使困惑，confess 指承认

examples.src: She blushed when he praised her.
examples.dst: 他夸奖她时，她脸红了。

examples.src: He felt a blush rising to his cheeks.
examples.dst: 他感到脸颊泛起红晕。

examples.src: I blush to think of how rude I was.
examples.dst: 一想到自己当时多么无礼，我就感到羞愧。

confuse.diff: brush 指刷子，blush 指脸红
flush 也可指脸红，但多指因发热或激动而发红

examples.src: Domestic sales rose by five percent.
examples.dst: 国内销售额增长了百分之五。

examples.src: Domestic violence is a serious social problem.
examples.dst: 家庭暴力是一个严重的社会问题。

examples.src: Dogs and cats are domestic animals.
examples.dst: 狗和猫是家养动物。

confuse.diff: dominant 指占主导的,domestic 指国内的或家庭的

examples.src: There are several good restaurants in the vicinity.
examples.dst: 附近有几家不错的餐馆。

examples.src: The accident happened in the vicinity of the station.
examples.dst: 事故发生在车站附近。

examples.src: No one in the vicinity saw anything.
examples.dst: 附近没有人看到任何东西。

confuse.diff: vicinage 是较少见的同义词，vicinity 更常用

examples.src: You do him a disservice by doing his homework.
examples.dst: 你替他做作业其实是在害他。

examples.src: The report did a disservice to the school.
examples.dst: 这份报告损害了学校的利益。

examples.src: Cutting the budget would do a disservice to patients.
examples.dst: 削减预算会对病人造成伤害。

confuse.diff: 常用搭配 do sb a disservice，意为对某人帮倒忙

examples.src: She received an anonymous letter.
examples.dst: 她收到了一封匿名信。

examples.src: The donor wishes to remain anonymous.
examples.dst: 捐赠者希望保持匿名。

examples.src: The survey is completely anonymous.
examples.dst: 这项调查完全匿名。

confuse.diff: unanimous 指全体一致的，anonymous 指匿名的

examples.src: A helicopter landed on the roof of the hospital.
examples.dst: 一架直升机降落在医院楼顶。

examples.src: The injured climber was rescued by helicopter.
examples.dst: 受伤的登山者被直升机救走。

examples.src: We watched the helicopter fly over the city.
examples.dst: 我们看着直升机飞越城市上空。

examples.src: He is a snob who looks down on anyone poorer than himself.
examples.dst: 他是个势利小人，瞧不起任何比他穷的人。

examples.src: She's such a snob about food and wine.
examples.dst: 她对美食和美酒极其挑剔又自命不凡。

examples.src: Don't be a snob, give the cheap restaurant a try.
examples.dst: 别那么势利，试试这家便宜的餐馆吧。

confuse.diff: snub 指冷落、怠慢，snob 指势利的人

examples.src: She woke up screaming from a nightmare.
examples.dst: 她从噩梦中尖叫着醒来。

examples.src: Finding a parking space in the city is a nightmare.
examples.dst: 在市区找停车位简直是一场噩梦。

examples.src: The accident was a nightmare for the whole family.
examples.dst: 这场事故对全家人来说是一场噩梦。

examples.src: Please remain seated until the plane stops.
examples.dst: 飞机停稳之前请坐着不要动。

examples.src: Only a few copies of the book remain.
examples.dst: 这本书只剩下几本了。

examples.src: The cause of the fire remains unknown.
examples.dst: 起火原因仍然不明。

confuse.diff: remind 指提醒，remain 指保持或留下

examples.src: We have a moral duty to help others.
examples.dst: 我们有帮助他人的道德责任。

examples.src: The moral of the story is to be honest.
examples.dst: 这个故事的寓意是要诚实。

examples.src: He is a man of high moral standards.
examples.dst: 他是个道德标准很高的人。

confuse.diff: moral 指道德的；morale 指士气。

means: 令人信服的，有说服力的

examples.src: She gave a convincing reason for being late.
examples.dst: 她给出了一个令人信服的迟到理由。

examples.src: The actor was very convincing as a doctor.
examples.dst: 这位演员扮演医生非常有说服力。

examples.src: There is no convincing evidence yet.
examples.dst: 目前还没有令人信服的证据。

confuse.diff: convinced 指确信的，主语通常是人

examples.src: We communicate by phone every day.
examples.dst: 我们每天通过电话交流。

examples.src: It is important to communicate with your parents.
examples.dst: 和父母沟通很重要。

examples.src: Dolphins communicate with sounds.
examples.dst: 海豚用声音交流。

confuse.diff: communicate 是动词，交流；communication 是名词，交流。

examples.src: Please pay the invoice within thirty days.
examples.dst: 请在三十天内支付发票款项。

examples.src: The supplier sent us an invoice for the goods.
examples.dst: 供应商给我们寄来了货物的发票。

examples.src: The company invoiced the client for the extra work.
examples.dst: 公司就额外的工作向客户开了账单。

confuse.diff: invoice 是索款的发票；receipt 是付款后的收据。

examples.src: The ocean liner sailed from Southampton.
examples.dst: 远洋客轮从南安普敦起航。

examples.src: Put a liner in the trash can.
examples.dst: 在垃圾桶里放一个垃圾袋。

examples.src: She applied eye liner before the party.
examples.dst: 她在聚会前画了眼线。

confuse.diff: linen 指亚麻布
liar 指说谎者

examples.src: The old wall began to crumble.
examples.dst: 那堵旧墙开始坍塌。

examples.src: Crumble the cheese over the salad.
examples.dst: 把奶酪捏碎撒在沙拉上。

examples.src: Their empire slowly crumbled.
examples.dst: 他们的帝国渐渐瓦解了。

confuse.diff: crumple 指弄皱或揉皱，crumble 指碎裂或崩溃

examples.src: The children chattered all the way home.
examples.dst: 孩子们一路上叽叽喳喳说个不停。

examples.src: His teeth chattered with cold.
examples.dst: 他冷得牙齿直打战。

examples.src: I could hear the chatter of birds outside.
examples.dst: 我能听到外面鸟儿的啁啾声。

confuse.diff: chapter 指章节，chatter 指喋喋不休

examples.src: Follow me, please.
examples.dst: 请跟我来。

examples.src: The dog followed the boy home.
examples.dst: 小狗跟着男孩回了家。

examples.src: Follow the rules at school.
examples.dst: 在学校要遵守规则。

confuse.diff: follow 是跟随；fellow 是同伴、家伙。

examples.src: The bull charged at the red cloth.
examples.dst: 公牛朝红布冲了过去。

examples.src: A bull elephant can weigh over six tons.
examples.dst: 一头雄象的体重可超过六吨。

examples.src: The farmer keeps a bull and twenty cows.
examples.dst: 农夫养了一头公牛和二十头母牛。

confuse.diff: bill 指账单或鸟嘴
bully 指欺凌弱小者

examples.src: A balanced diet nourishes the body and the brain.
examples.dst: 均衡饮食滋养身体和大脑。

examples.src: Rivers nourish the soil of the valley.
examples.dst: 河流滋养着山谷的土壤。

examples.src: Teachers should nourish children's curiosity.

confuse.diff: economical指节约的,economic指经济的

examples.src: The lake has an outlet to the sea.
examples.dst: 这个湖有一条通向大海的出口。

examples.src: Sport is a healthy outlet for anger.
examples.dst: 运动是发泄怒气的健康途径。

examples.src: The brand opened a new factory outlet in town.
examples.dst: 这个品牌在城里开了一家新的工厂直销店。

confuse.diff: outlook 指前景或观点,outlet 指出口或销路

examples.src: Pencil lead is made of graphite and clay.
examples.dst: 铅笔芯由石墨和黏土制成。

examples.src: Graphite conducts electricity well.
examples.dst: 石墨导电性良好。

examples.src: Diamond and graphite are both forms of carbon.
examples.dst: 钻石和石墨都是碳的形态。

confuse.diff: graph 是图表
granite 是花岗岩

examples.src: The forecast predicts occasional showers this afternoon.
examples.dst: 天气预报说今天下午偶有阵雨。

examples.src: He makes an occasional visit to his hometown.
examples.dst: 他偶尔回一趟老家。

examples.src: The article is an occasional piece written for the festival.
examples.dst: 这篇文章是为这个节日而写的应景之作。

confuse.diff: occasionally是副词,occasional是形容词

examples.src: The birds fly southwards in winter.
examples.dst: 鸟儿在冬天向南飞。

examples.src: We drove southwards along the coast.
examples.dst: 我们沿着海岸向南行驶。

examples.src: The river flows southwards into the sea.
examples.dst: 这条河向南流入大海。

confuse.diff: southward 也可作形容词，southwards 在英式英语中更常作副词
southern 是形容词，意为南方的

examples.src: The earth turns on its axis.
examples.dst: 地球绕着自转轴转动。

examples.src: The x-axis shows time and the y-axis shows distance.
examples.dst: x轴表示时间,y轴表示距离。

examples.src: The building is built along a north-south axis.
examples.dst: 这座建筑沿南北轴线而建。

confuse.diff: axe指斧头,axis指轴

examples.src: Given the weather, the match was cancelled.
examples.dst: 考虑到天气，比赛被取消了。

examples.src: Complete the task within the given time.
examples.dst: 在规定时间内完成任务。

examples.src: He is given to exaggerating.
examples.dst: 他爱夸大其词。

confuse.diff: given name 指名字，不是姓

examples.src: A large crowd gathered in the square.
examples.dst: 一大群人聚集在广场上。

examples.src: Fans crowded around the singer.
examples.dst: 粉丝们围拢在歌手周围。

examples.src: The crowd cheered when the team scored.
examples.dst: 球队得分时，人群欢呼起来。

confuse.diff: crowded 是形容词，意为拥挤的

examples.src: Sound cannot travel through a vacuum.
examples.dst: 声音无法在真空中传播。

examples.src: The leader's resignation created a power vacuum.
examples.dst: 领导人的辞职造成了权力真空。

examples.src: She vacuumed the carpet before the guests arrived.
examples.dst: 客人到来前她用吸尘器打扫了地毯。

examples.src: The farmers threshed the wheat by hand.
examples.dst: 农民们用手给小麦脱粒。

examples.src: A machine now threshes the grain in hours.
examples.dst: 现在机器几小时就能给谷物脱粒。

examples.src: They threshed the rice before the rain came.
examples.dst: 他们在下雨前给稻谷脱了粒。

confuse.diff: thrash 是痛打、猛烈挥动
threshold 是门槛、界限

examples.src: The jacket is made of heavy cotton jean.
examples.dst: 这件夹克用厚实的粗斜纹棉布制成。

examples.src: He bought a pair of blue jeans.
examples.dst: 他买了一条蓝色牛仔裤。

examples.src: Jean cloth was first used for work clothes.
examples.dst: 粗斜纹布最初用来做工作服。

confuse.diff: gene 指基因，jean 指粗斜纹布，两者读音相近

examples.src: Rice and wheat are important grains.
examples.dst: 稻米和小麦是重要的谷物。

examples.src: There was a grain of sand in his shoe.
examples.dst: 他的鞋里有一粒沙子。

examples.src: The country produces enough grain for its people.
examples.dst: 这个国家生产的粮食足够其人民食用。

confuse.diff: brain 意为大脑

examples.src: The evidence proved his guilt.
examples.dst: 证据证明了他有罪。

examples.src: She felt a deep sense of guilt after the argument.
examples.dst: 争吵之后，她感到深深的内疚。

examples.src: He admitted his guilt in court.
examples.dst: 他在法庭上承认了罪行。

confuse.diff: guilty 是形容词，指有罪的、内疚的
gilt 指镀金，读音相同

examples.src: He told a vulgar joke at the dinner table.
examples.dst: 他在餐桌上讲了一个粗俗的笑话。

examples.src: She thought the decoration was vulgar.
examples.dst: 她觉得这种装饰很俗气。

examples.src: Vulgar language is not allowed in class.
examples.dst: 课堂上不允许说粗话。

confuse.diff: vulgarity 是名词，意为粗俗
vulnerable 是易受伤害的

examples.src: The dog gnawed a bone in the yard.
examples.dst: 狗在院子里啃骨头。

examples.src: Mice gnawed through the wire.
examples.dst: 老鼠把电线咬断了。

examples.src: Doubt kept gnawing at him.
examples.dst: 疑虑一直折磨着他。

confuse.diff: nag 是唠叨、不断烦扰
并非规范英语单词，注意 gnaw 开头的 g 不发音

examples.src: A government spokesman announced the new policy.
examples.dst: 一位政府发言人宣布了新政策。

examples.src: The company's spokesman refused to comment.
examples.dst: 公司发言人拒绝置评。

examples.src: He was chosen as the spokesman for the students.
examples.dst: 他被推选为学生代表发言人。

confuse.diff: spokesperson不分性别,spokesman特指男性或传统用法

examples.src: The legend says the family lives under a curse.
examples.dst: 传说这个家族受到了诅咒。

examples.src: He cursed loudly when he dropped the plate.
examples.dst: 盘子掉在地上时他大声咒骂。

examples.src: Traffic jams are the curse of modern cities.
examples.dst: 交通拥堵是现代城市的祸害。

confuse.diff: course 指课程或过程，curse 指诅咒

examples.src: He built a sturdy wooden table.
examples.dst: 他做了一张结实的木桌。

examples.src: The boy has sturdy legs.
examples.dst: 这个男孩的腿很结实。

examples.src: The company put up sturdy resistance to the takeover.
examples.dst: 公司对收购进行了坚决的抵制。

confuse.diff: study 是学习、研究
常见拼写错误，正确拼写为 sturdy

examples.src: What is the main criterion for choosing a job?
examples.dst: 选择工作的主要标准是什么？

examples.src: Honesty is a criterion for a good friend.
examples.dst: 诚实是好朋友的一条标准。

examples.src: The school has strict criteria for admission.
examples.dst: 学校的录取标准很严格。

confuse.diff: criterion 指标准；critic 指评论家。

examples.src: Many voters seem indifferent to the election.
examples.dst: 许多选民似乎对选举漠不关心。

examples.src: The teacher cannot remain indifferent to students' suffering.
examples.dst: 老师不能对学生的痛苦无动于衷。

examples.src: The restaurant serves indifferent food at high prices.
examples.dst: 这家餐厅提供价格高但质量平庸的食物。

confuse.diff: different指不同的,indifferent指漠不关心的

examples.src: The chairman convened a meeting of the board.
examples.dst: 主席召集了董事会会议。

examples.src: Parliament will convene next Monday.
examples.dst: 议会将于下周一开会。

examples.src: Leaders convened to discuss climate change.
examples.dst: 领导人们聚集讨论气候变化。

confuse.diff: convey 指传达、运送

examples.src: Try to visualize the scene described in the text.
examples.dst: 试着在脑海中想象文中描述的场景。

examples.src: Charts help us visualize complex data.
examples.dst: 图表帮助我们直观地呈现复杂数据。

examples.src: Athletes often visualize success before a race.
examples.dst: 运动员常在比赛前想象成功的画面。

confuse.diff: visualise 是英式拼写，visualize 是美式拼写，意思相同

examples.src: The lost hikers were desperate for help.
examples.dst: 迷路的徒步者急需帮助。

examples.src: He made a desperate attempt to escape.
examples.dst: 他拼命想要逃脱。

examples.src: She felt desperate when she lost her job.
examples.dst: 失业时她感到绝望。

confuse.diff: desperate 指绝望的；separate 指分开的。

examples.src: Some students prefer lectures, whereas others like group discussions.
examples.dst: 有些学生喜欢听讲座，而另一些则喜欢小组讨论。

examples.src: The first method is cheap, whereas the second is expensive.
examples.dst: 第一种方法便宜，而第二种很昂贵。

examples.src: Urban areas are crowded, whereas rural areas are sparsely populated.
examples.dst: 城市地区拥挤，而农村地区人口稀少。

confuse.diff: whereby 意为“借此”，whereas 表示对比

examples.src: Many species are facing extinction.
examples.dst: 许多物种正面临灭绝。

examples.src: The extinction of the dinosaurs happened long ago.
examples.dst: 恐龙灭绝发生在很久以前。

examples.src: We must save these animals from extinction.
examples.dst: 我们必须拯救这些动物，使它们免于灭绝。

confuse.diff: extinction 是名词，意为灭绝；extinct 是形容词，意为灭绝的。

examples.src: Global warming is a serious threat to our planet.
examples.dst: 全球变暖对我们的星球是严重的威胁。

examples.src: The Internet has made global communication much easier.
examples.dst: 互联网使全球交流变得容易得多。

examples.src: The company plans to expand its global business.
examples.dst: 这家公司计划扩大其全球业务。

confuse.diff: global 是形容词，指全球的；globe 是名词，指地球、地球仪。

examples.src: Pollution is causing serious ecological damage.
examples.dst: 污染正在造成严重的生态破坏。

examples.src: The wetland is an important ecological system.
examples.dst: 这片湿地是重要的生态系统。

examples.src: They are working to restore the ecological balance of the lake.
examples.dst: 他们正在努力恢复这个湖泊的生态平衡。

confuse.diff: economical 是节约的
economic 是经济的

examples.src: Many migrants move to cities to find work.
examples.dst: 许多外来务工人员搬到城市找工作。

examples.src: The migrant workers built the new road.
examples.dst: 流动工人修建了这条新路。

examples.src: Swallows are migrant birds.
examples.dst: 燕子是候鸟。

confuse.diff: migrant 泛指迁移者；immigrant 指移入某国的移民。

examples.src: The classroom has a rectangular table in the middle.
examples.dst: 教室中间有一张长方形的桌子。

examples.src: She bought a rectangular box for her pencils.
examples.dst: 她买了一个长方形的盒子装铅笔。

examples.src: The pool is rectangular and ten meters long.
examples.dst: 这个游泳池是长方形的,长十米。

confuse.diff: rectangle是名词,长方形;rectangular是形容词

examples.src: I don't like to listen to gossip.
examples.dst: 我不喜欢听闲话。

examples.src: They gossiped about their neighbors for an hour.
examples.dst: 他们聊了一个小时邻居的八卦。

examples.src: There is a lot of gossip about the movie star.
examples.dst: 关于那位电影明星有很多流言。

confuse.diff: gossip 指闲话；gospel 指福音。

examples.src: The baby was born prematurely.
examples.dst: 这个婴儿是早产的。

examples.src: Don't draw conclusions too prematurely.
examples.dst: 不要过早下结论。

examples.src: His hair turned grey prematurely.
examples.dst: 他的头发过早地变白了。

confuse.diff: premature 是形容词，意为过早的
immaturely 是不成熟地

examples.src: The dog is tied up with a chain.
examples.dst: 狗被一条链子拴着。

examples.src: She wears a gold chain around her neck.
examples.dst: 她脖子上戴着一条金项链。

examples.src: In the food chain, big fish eat small fish.
examples.dst: 在食物链中,大鱼吃小鱼。

examples.src: A wide staircase leads to the second floor.
examples.dst: 一道宽阔的楼梯通向二楼。

examples.src: She slipped on the wet staircase.
examples.dst: 她在湿滑的楼梯上滑倒了。

examples.src: The old house has a spiral staircase.
examples.dst: 这栋老房子有一道旋转楼梯。

confuse.diff: stairwell 指楼梯井
escalator 指自动扶梯

examples.src: The apples began to rot in the box.
examples.dst: 苹果在箱子里开始腐烂。

examples.src: Wood will rot if it stays wet.
examples.dst: 木头一直潮湿就会腐朽。

examples.src: Too many sweets will rot your teeth.
examples.dst: 吃太多糖会蛀牙。

confuse.diff: rot 指腐烂；rod 指杆。

examples.src: The company announced a layoff of two hundred workers.
examples.dst: 公司宣布裁员两百人。

examples.src: Many families suffered from the factory layoff.
examples.dst: 许多家庭因工厂裁员而受到影响。

examples.src: After a long layoff, the player returned to the team.
examples.dst: 长时间停赛之后，这名球员回到了球队。

layout 是布局

examples.src: The magnet has two ends of opposite polarity.
examples.dst: 这块磁铁两端的极性相反。

examples.dst: 在这个问题上，意见的对立正在加剧。

examples.dst: 把电池极性接反损坏了设备。

confuse.diff: polarity 指极性或对立状态；polarization 指分化或极化的过程。

examples.src: The quantity of water in the tank is small.
examples.dst: 水箱里的水量很少。

examples.src: Quality is more important than quantity.
examples.dst: 质量比数量更重要。

examples.src: She bought a large quantity of rice.
examples.dst: 她买了大量的大米。

confuse.diff: quantity 指数量；quality 指质量。

examples.src: Could you xerox this page for me?

examples.dst: 她复印了合同并把复印件归档。

examples.src: I need a xerox of my passport.
examples.dst: 我需要一份护照的复印件。

examples.src: Racial discrimination is against the law.
examples.dst: 种族歧视是违法的。

examples.src: The company was accused of age discrimination.
examples.dst: 这家公司被指控有年龄歧视。

examples.src: She has good discrimination in music.
examples.dst: 她对音乐有很好的鉴别力。

confuse.diff: discriminate是动词歧视,discrimination是名词歧视

examples.src: He is a pessimist and always expects the worst.
examples.dst: 他是个悲观主义者，总是做最坏的打算。

examples.src: Don't be such a pessimist; things will get better.
examples.dst: 别那么悲观，情况会好起来的。

examples.src: A pessimist sees the difficulty in every opportunity.
examples.dst: 悲观的人在每个机会中都只看到困难。

confuse.diff: optimist 是乐观主义者，pessimist 是悲观主义者

examples.src: She stewed the beef for three hours.
examples.dst: 她把牛肉炖了三个小时。

examples.src: The beef stew smells delicious.
examples.dst: 这锅炖牛肉闻起来很香。

examples.src: Let the fruit stew gently until it is soft.
examples.dst: 让水果用小火慢炖到变软。

confuse.diff: steward 指乘务员、管家，stew 指炖

examples.src: She studies economics at university.
examples.dst: 她在大学里学习经济学。

examples.src: The economics of the project are not clear.
examples.dst: 这个项目的经济状况还不明朗。

examples.src: Economics explains how people use limited resources.
examples.dst: 经济学解释人们如何使用有限的资源。

confuse.diff: economics 指经济学；economy 指经济体或节约。

examples.src: The court's ruling surprised everyone.
examples.dst: 法院的裁决让所有人都感到意外。

examples.src: The ruling party won the election again.
examples.dst: 执政党再次赢得了选举。

examples.src: The company appealed against the ruling.
examples.dst: 公司对该裁定提出了上诉。

confuse.diff: ruler 指统治者或尺子，ruling 指裁定

examples.src: She is currently working in Paris.
examples.dst: 她目前在巴黎工作。

examples.src: The road is currently closed.
examples.dst: 这条路目前封闭。

examples.src: Which version are you currently using?
examples.dst: 你现在用的是哪个版本？

confuse.diff: 常见拼写错误，正确拼写是 currently

examples.src: The cat slept on the hearth.
examples.dst: 猫睡在壁炉前的地面上。

examples.src: They sat around the hearth telling stories.
examples.dst: 他们围坐在炉边讲故事。

examples.src: The old stone hearth keeps the room warm.
examples.dst: 古老的石砌壁炉让房间保持温暖。

confuse.diff: heart 指心脏，hearth 指炉边
earth 指地球、泥土

examples.src: The region is characterized by hot summers.
examples.dst: 该地区的特点是夏季炎热。

examples.src: He characterized the plan as unrealistic.
examples.dst: 他把这个计划形容为不切实际。

examples.src: Generosity characterizes her whole family.
examples.dst: 慷慨是她全家人的特点。

confuse.diff: character 是名词，指性格、特征；characterize 是动词

examples.src: She felt instant relief after taking the medicine.
examples.dst: 吃药之后，她立刻感到轻松了。

examples.src: I like instant coffee in the morning.
examples.dst: 我早上喜欢喝速溶咖啡。

examples.src: In an instant, the lights went out.
examples.dst: 一瞬间灯就灭了。

confuse.diff: instance 指实例，instant 指立即的或瞬间

examples.src: Honey is a viscous liquid that flows slowly.
examples.dst: 蜂蜜是一种流动缓慢的黏稠液体。

examples.src: Cold weather makes engine oil more viscous.
examples.dst: 寒冷的天气会使机油变得更黏稠。

examples.src: The scientists measured how viscous the fluid was.
examples.dst: 科学家们测量了这种液体的黏度。

confuse.diff: viscous 是黏稠的；vicious 是凶恶的、恶毒的。

examples.src: The doctor told me to take two capsules a day.
examples.dst: 医生让我每天服两粒胶囊。

examples.src: The space capsule landed in the ocean.
examples.dst: 太空舱降落在海洋里。

examples.src: They buried a time capsule under the tree.
examples.dst: 他们在树下埋了一个时间胶囊。

confuse.diff: capture 指捕获，capsule 指胶囊

examples.src: The vase is too delicate to carry in a bag.
examples.dst: 这只花瓶太易碎，不能放在包里带。

examples.src: She wore a delicate silver necklace.
examples.dst: 她戴着一条精致的银项链。

examples.src: This is a delicate matter and needs care.
examples.dst: 这是个微妙的问题，需要谨慎处理。

confuse.diff: delicate 指精致的、脆弱的；delicious 指美味的。

examples.src: The absorption of water by the roots is slow.
examples.dst: 根部对水分的吸收很缓慢。

examples.src: He read with complete absorption.
examples.dst: 他读书时全神贯注。

examples.src: The absorption of the small firm took a year.
examples.dst: 这家小公司被并入花了一年时间。

confuse.diff: adsorption 是吸附，附着在表面，absorption 是吸收进内部

examples.src: A snail crawled slowly across the leaf.
examples.dst: 一只蜗牛慢慢爬过叶子。

examples.src: The traffic moved at a snail's pace.
examples.dst: 车流像蜗牛一样缓慢移动。

examples.src: Snails carry their shells on their backs.
examples.dst: 蜗牛把壳背在背上。

confuse.diff: snake 是蛇，snail 是蜗牛
nail 指钉子、指甲

examples.src: A spark from the fire landed on the dry grass.
examples.dst: 篝火的一粒火星落在了干草上。

examples.src: The decision sparked protests across the country.
examples.dst: 这一决定在全国引发了抗议。

examples.src: The teacher's talk sparked her interest in science.
examples.dst: 老师的讲话激发了她对科学的兴趣。

confuse.diff: spare意为备用的或腾出,spark指火花

examples.src: Our team won the 4x100 metre relay.
examples.dst: 我们队赢得了 4x100 米接力赛。

examples.src: Satellites relay television signals around the world.
examples.dst: 卫星把电视信号转播到世界各地。

examples.src: She relayed the message to the manager.
examples.dst: 她把消息转达给了经理。

confuse.diff: delay 指延误，relay 指接力或转发

examples.src: Xinjiang is an autonomous region of China.
examples.dst: 新疆是中国的一个自治区。

examples.src: The company is developing autonomous cars.
examples.dst: 这家公司正在研发自动驾驶汽车。

examples.src: Teenagers want to be more autonomous in their choices.
examples.dst: 青少年希望在选择上更加自主。

confuse.diff: automatic指自动的,autonomous指自治或自主的

examples.src: Fishing boats returned to the harbour at dusk.

examples.dst: 签证持有者可以带家属入境。

confuse.diff: dependent是形容词,指依赖的,dependant是名词,指受抚养者(美式常拼作dependent)

examples.src: The media tends to exaggerate the risks.
examples.dst: 媒体往往夸大风险。

examples.src: I'm not exaggerating when I say the exam was hard.
examples.dst: 我说考试很难并不是夸张。

examples.dst: 他在面试中夸大了自己的成就。

confuse.diff: exacerbate意为使恶化,exaggerate意为夸大

examples.src: The experiment produced a bizarre result.
examples.dst: 这次实验产生了一个怪异的结果。

examples.src: It was a bizarre coincidence that they met again.
examples.dst: 他们再次相遇,真是离奇的巧合。

examples.dst: 这部电影的情节离奇古怪。

examples.src: The disease was widespread in the area.

examples.dst: 人们普遍关注气候变化。

examples.dst: 智能手机在学生中已经普及。

confuse.diff: widespread 是形容词，意为广泛的；spread 是动词，意为传播。

examples.src: The timid girl hid behind her mother.
examples.dst: 那个胆小的女孩躲在妈妈身后。

examples.dst: 他怯生生地敲了敲门。

examples.dst: 兔子是胆小的动物。

confuse.diff: tepid 指微温的，timid 指胆小的

examples.src: Don't make a hasty decision.
examples.dst: 不要匆忙作决定。

examples.src: They made a hasty exit from the room.
examples.dst: 他们匆忙离开了房间。

examples.dst: 匆匆忙忙吃饭对健康不利。

examples.src: The waitress brought us the menu.
examples.dst: 女服务员给我们拿来了菜单。

examples.dst: 她在一家小餐馆当女服务员。

examples.src: We left a tip for the waitress.
examples.dst: 我们给女服务员留了小费。

confuse.diff: waiter 指男服务员，waitress 指女服务员

examples.src: The film received a lot of publicity before its release.
examples.dst: 这部电影上映前得到了大量宣传。

examples.src: The company hired a team to handle publicity.
examples.dst: 公司雇了一个团队负责宣传。

examples.src: The scandal brought unwelcome publicity.
examples.dst: 这起丑闻带来了不受欢迎的关注。

confuse.diff: publicly是副词,意为公开地;publicity是名词

examples.src: The agency launched a new satellite last month.
examples.dst: 该机构上个月发射了一颗新卫星。

examples.src: The company will launch its latest smartphone in May.
examples.dst: 公司将在五月推出最新款智能手机。

examples.src: The launch of the campaign attracted wide attention.
examples.dst: 这场运动的启动引起了广泛关注。

confuse.diff: lunch 指午餐
launder 指洗涤，或洗钱

examples.src: He learned carpentry from his grandfather.
examples.dst: 他跟爷爷学会了木工手艺。

examples.src: The school offers courses in carpentry and plumbing.
examples.dst: 这所学校开设木工和管道工课程。

examples.src: Fine carpentry takes patience and skill.
examples.dst: 精细的木工活需要耐心和技巧。

confuse.diff: carpet 指地毯，carpentry 指木工业

examples.src: The carpet has a geometrical pattern.
examples.dst: 这块地毯有几何图案。

examples.src: She solved the geometrical problem in minutes.
examples.dst: 她几分钟就解出了这道几何题。

examples.src: The building is known for its geometrical design.
examples.dst: 这座建筑以其几何造型而闻名。

confuse.diff: geographical 指地理的，geometrical 指几何的

examples.dst: 每月的保险费上涨了。

examples.src: Customers pay a premium for organic food.
examples.dst: 顾客为有机食品多付溢价。

examples.src: The shop sells premium coffee beans.
examples.dst: 这家店出售优质咖啡豆。

confuse.diff: premium 指保险费或优质的；premier 指首相或首要的。

examples.src: Dead leaves decompose and enrich the soil.
examples.dst: 枯叶腐烂后会使土壤更肥沃。

examples.src: Bacteria decompose organic waste.
examples.dst: 细菌分解有机废物。

examples.src: The body had begun to decompose.
examples.dst: 尸体已经开始腐烂。

confuse.diff: compose 指组成、创作，decompose 指分解

examples.src: The law bans discrimination based on gender.
examples.dst: 法律禁止基于性别的歧视。

examples.src: Gender equality is a key goal of the programme.
examples.dst: 性别平等是该项目的重要目标。

examples.src: In French, every noun has a gender.
examples.dst: 在法语中，每个名词都有性。

confuse.diff: gender 指性别；gentle 指温和的。

examples.src: She won first prize in the singing competition.
examples.dst: 她在歌唱比赛中获得了一等奖。

examples.dst: 我们学校有一场演讲比赛。

examples.dst: 竞争非常激烈。

confuse.diff: compete是动词,competition是名词

examples.src: The plague killed millions of people in medieval Europe.
examples.dst: 瘟疫在中世纪的欧洲夺去了数百万人的生命。

examples.src: The region is plagued by drought.
examples.dst: 这一地区饱受干旱困扰。

examples.dst: 蝗灾毁坏了庄稼。

confuse.diff: plaque 指牙菌斑或纪念牌,plague 指瘟疫

examples.src: I have to finish my English assignment tonight.
examples.dst: 今晚我得完成英语作业。

examples.src: The reporter was sent on an assignment abroad.
examples.dst: 记者被派往国外执行任务。

examples.src: The assignment of seats took a long time.
examples.dst: 座位的分配花了很长时间。

confuse.diff: assign 是动词分配，assignment 是名词作业或任务

examples.src: The river overflowed after days of heavy rain.
examples.dst: 连日大雨后河水泛滥。

examples.src: The bath is about to overflow.
examples.dst: 浴缸里的水快溢出来了。

examples.src: The stadium was overflowing with fans.
examples.dst: 体育场里挤满了球迷。

confuse.diff: overflow 指溢出；overflight 指飞越领空。

examples.src: The job market is extremely competitive.
examples.dst: 就业市场竞争异常激烈。

examples.src: The company offers competitive salaries.
examples.dst: 公司提供有竞争力的薪资。

examples.src: He is very competitive and hates losing.
examples.dst: 他好胜心很强，讨厌输。

confuse.diff: competent 指有能力的，competitive 指竞争的

examples.src: The engine produces axial thrust.
examples.dst: 这台发动机产生轴向推力。

examples.src: Axial rotation of the earth causes day and night.
examples.dst: 地球绕轴自转形成昼夜。

examples.src: The scan shows an axial view of the brain.
examples.dst: 这张扫描图显示的是大脑的轴向切面。

confuse.diff: axle 指车轴，axial 是形容词，意为轴的

examples.src: After much persuasion, he agreed to join the club.
examples.dst: 经过再三劝说，他同意加入俱乐部。

examples.src: She has great powers of persuasion.
examples.dst: 她有很强的说服力。

examples.src: It took a lot of persuasion to make him change his mind.
examples.dst: 花了很多功夫劝说才让他改变主意。

confuse.diff: persuasion 是名词，说服；persuade 是动词，说服。

examples.src: The bird flapped its wings and flew off.
examples.dst: 鸟扇动翅膀飞走了。

examples.src: The flags flapped in the strong wind.
examples.dst: 旗帜在强风中猎猎作响。

examples.src: Pilots adjust the wing flaps before landing.
examples.dst: 飞行员在着陆前调整机翼的襟翼。

confuse.diff: flap 指拍动、扇动；flip 指翻转、轻弹。

examples.src: He didn't study hard; consequently, he failed the exam.
examples.dst: 他没有努力学习，因此考试没及格。

examples.src: The road was closed and consequently we were late.
examples.dst: 道路被封了，因此我们迟到了。

examples.src: She missed the bus and consequently missed the meeting.
examples.dst: 她错过了公交车，因此错过了会议。

confuse.diff: consequently 强调因果；subsequently 强调时间上随后。

examples.src: A huge shape loomed out of the fog.
examples.dst: 一个巨大的轮廓在雾中隐约出现。

examples.src: The exams are looming, so she is studying hard.
examples.dst: 考试临近了，所以她学习很用功。

examples.dst: 布料是在木制织布机上织成的。

confuse.diff: loom 是织布机或隐现；loam 是壤土。

examples.src: We need to lengthen the runway.

examples.src: The days begin to lengthen in spring.

examples.src: Exercise can lengthen your life.
examples.dst: 锻炼能延长寿命。

confuse.diff: length 是名词，指长度，lengthen 是动词

examples.dst: 教练在下半场改变了战术。

examples.dst: 军事战术随着技术而改变。

examples.dst: 她在谈判中采用了拖延策略。

confuse.diff: strategy 指总体战略，tactics 指具体战术

examples.src: I read a biography of Albert Einstein last week.
examples.dst: 上周我读了一本爱因斯坦的传记。

examples.src: The biography tells the story of her life.
examples.dst: 这本传记讲述了她的生平。

examples.src: He wrote a short biography of the famous scientist.
examples.dst: 他为这位著名科学家写了一篇简短的传记。

confuse.diff: autobiography是自传,biography是他人写的传记

examples.src: The UN imposed economic sanctions on the country.
examples.dst: 联合国对该国实施了经济制裁。

examples.src: The council refused to sanction the building plan.
examples.dst: 市议会拒绝批准这项建筑计划。

examples.src: The project received official sanction last week.
examples.dst: 该项目上周获得了官方批准。

confuse.diff: sanctuary指庇护所,sanction指制裁或批准

examples.src: Words cannot convey how happy I am.
examples.dst: 言语无法表达我有多高兴。

examples.src: The poem conveys a feeling of loneliness.
examples.dst: 这首诗传达出一种孤独感。

examples.src: Pipes convey water to the village.
examples.dst: 管道把水输送到村里。

confuse.diff: convey 指传达、运送；convince 指使信服。

examples.src: The books are divided into several categories.

examples.dst: 她获得了最佳女演员奖项。

examples.dst: 缺水是该地区的一大难题。

examples.dst: 熟练工人的短缺拖慢了生产。

confuse.diff: scarcity 是名词；scarce 是形容词，指稀缺的。

examples.src: He bent down to untie his shoelaces.
examples.dst: 他弯下腰去解鞋带。

examples.dst: 请把绳子从柱子上解下来。

examples.dst: 她小心地解开了包裹。

examples.dst: 这次软件升级修复了几个漏洞。

examples.dst: 这台电脑的数据处理速度很快。

examples.src: The laws protect the rights of minorities.

examples.dst: 一公里大约相当于0.62英里。

examples.dst: 她在管弦乐队里演奏竖琴。

examples.dst: 这架竖琴有四十七根弦。

examples.dst: 他总是没完没了地提起他以前的工作。

examples.src: He works at the Metropolitan Museum of Art.
examples.dst: 他在大都会艺术博物馆工作。

examples.dst: 大都市的生活节奏可能很快，压力也大。

examples.dst: 电动汽车越来越受欢迎。

examples.src: Private vehicles are not allowed in the city centre.
examples.dst: 私家车不得进入市中心。

examples.src: Television is a powerful vehicle for advertising.
examples.dst: 电视是一种强大的广告媒介。

confuse.diff: vegetable 指蔬菜,vehicle 指车辆

examples.dst: 他在热狗上涂了芥末酱。

examples.dst: 英式芥末味道很冲。

examples.src: The field was full of yellow mustard flowers.
examples.dst: 田里开满了黄色的芥菜花。

examples.src: They went for a ramble along the river.

examples.src: We have not yet set a definite date for the meeting.

examples.src: There has been a definite improvement in her health.

examples.src: He plans to travel after his retirement.

examples.src: The mountains disappeared into the mist.
examples.dst: 群山消失在薄雾之中。

examples.src: Her glasses misted up when she entered the warm room.
examples.dst: 她走进暖和的房间时，眼镜上蒙了一层水汽。

confuse.diff: mist 指较薄的雾；fog 指较浓的雾，能见度更低。

examples.src: The company targets the youth segment of the market.

examples.src: Wash your hands so that you do not contaminate the samples.

examples.src: Experts tried to decode the secret message.

examples.src: The box decodes the digital signal.
examples.dst: 这个盒子对数字信号进行解码。

examples.src: Scientists have decoded the human genome.
examples.dst: 科学家已经解读了人类基因组。

confuse.diff: decade 指十年，decode 指解码

examples.src: It's my fault. I'm sorry.

examples.src: Everyone has faults.
examples.dst: 每个人都有缺点。

examples.src: There is a fault in the machine.
examples.dst: 这台机器出了故障。

examples.src: Public perception of the policy is changing.
examples.dst: 公众对这项政策的看法正在改变。

examples.src: Bats have a different perception of the world.

examples.src: The ad changed people's perception of the brand.
examples.dst: 这则广告改变了人们对品牌的印象。

examples.src: Burning coal produces carbon dioxide and other gases.

examples.dst: 人们现在的闲暇时间比过去多。

examples.src: He reads novels at his leisure.
examples.dst: 他在空闲时读小说。

examples.src: The leisure industry is growing rapidly.
examples.dst: 休闲产业正在迅速发展。

confuse.diff: pleasure 指愉快
leisurely 是形容词，指悠闲的

examples.src: She bought a tub of ice cream.
examples.dst: 她买了一大桶冰淇淋。

examples.src: He filled the tub with hot water.
examples.dst: 他往浴缸里放满了热水。

examples.src: The flowers are planted in a wooden tub.
examples.dst: 花种在一个木桶里。

confuse.diff: tube 指管子，tub 指桶、盆

examples.src: The monk gave up all his worldly possessions.
examples.dst: 那位僧人放弃了所有世俗财物。

examples.src: She is young and lacks worldly experience.
examples.dst: 她还年轻，缺乏处世经验。

examples.src: He cared little for worldly success.
examples.dst: 他不太在意世俗的成功。

confuse.diff: wordy 指啰嗦的，worldly 指世俗的

examples.src: Thousands joined a rally in support of the new law.
examples.dst: 数千人参加了支持新法律的集会。

examples.src: Share prices rallied after the announcement.
examples.dst: 消息公布后股价出现反弹。

examples.src: Volunteers rallied to help the flood victims.
examples.dst: 志愿者们集结起来帮助洪灾受害者。

confuse.diff: rely指依赖,rally指集结或集会

examples.src: Many immigrants came to the United States in search of a better life.
examples.dst: 许多移民来到美国寻求更好的生活。

examples.src: His grandparents were immigrants from Italy.
examples.dst: 他的祖父母是来自意大利的移民。

examples.src: The city has a large immigrant population.
examples.dst: 这座城市有大量移民人口。

confuse.diff: immigrant 指移入的人；emigrant 指移出的人。

examples.src: The company is responsive to customer complaints.
examples.dst: 该公司对客户投诉反应积极。

examples.src: The website has a responsive design that works on any screen.
examples.dst: 这个网站采用响应式设计，适用于任何屏幕。

examples.src: The teacher was responsive to the needs of her students.
examples.dst: 这位教师能积极回应学生的需求。

confuse.diff: responsible 指负责任的，responsive 指反应灵敏的

examples.src: The company went bankrupt during the recession.
examples.dst: 这家公司在经济衰退期间破产了。

examples.src: The scandal bankrupted the firm.
examples.dst: 这起丑闻使该公司破产。

examples.src: He was declared bankrupt last year.
examples.dst: 他去年被宣告破产。

confuse.diff: bankrupt 是形容词；bankruptcy 是名词，指破产。

examples.src: Primitive people used stones as tools.
examples.dst: 原始人用石头做工具。

examples.src: The cabin had only primitive cooking facilities.
examples.dst: 这间小屋只有简陋的炊具。

examples.src: The museum displays primitive forms of writing.
examples.dst: 博物馆展出了早期的文字形式。

confuse.diff: primary指首要的或初级的,primitive指原始的

examples.src: He is a considerate boy who always helps others.
examples.dst: 他是个体贴的男孩，总是帮助别人。

examples.src: It was considerate of you to call me.
examples.dst: 你给我打电话真是体贴。

examples.src: Be considerate to your neighbours at night.
examples.dst: 晚上要体谅你的邻居。

confuse.diff: considerable 意为相当大的，可观的

examples.src: Easter is in spring.
examples.dst: 复活节在春天。

examples.src: Children look for eggs at Easter.
examples.dst: 孩子们在复活节找彩蛋。

examples.src: We will visit my grandma at Easter.
examples.dst: 复活节我们要去看望奶奶。

confuse.diff: east 指东方,Easter 是复活节

examples.src: It is easy to overlook small details in an experiment.
examples.dst: 在实验中很容易忽略小细节。

examples.src: Our hotel room overlooks the sea.
examples.dst: 我们的酒店房间可以俯瞰大海。

examples.src: The teacher decided to overlook his first mistake.
examples.dst: 老师决定不追究他的第一次错误。

confuse.diff: oversee指监督管理,overlook指忽视或俯瞰

examples.src: I made a tuna sandwich for lunch.
examples.dst: 我午饭做了一个金枪鱼三明治。

examples.src: Tuna are fast swimmers that travel long distances.
examples.dst: 金枪鱼游得很快，能长途迁徙。

examples.src: Canned tuna is a cheap source of protein.
examples.dst: 金枪鱼罐头是廉价的蛋白质来源。

confuse.diff: tune 指曲调，tuna 指金枪鱼

examples.src: We drove along a winding mountain road.
examples.dst: 我们沿着一条蜿蜒的山路行驶。

examples.src: A narrow winding stream runs through the valley.
examples.dst: 一条狭窄曲折的小溪穿过山谷。

examples.src: The winding of the coil takes several hours.
examples.dst: 绕制线圈需要几个小时。

confuse.diff: wounding 指伤害的，winding 指蜿蜒的

examples.src: Newton and Leibniz independently developed calculus.
examples.dst: 牛顿和莱布尼茨各自独立发展出了微积分。

examples.src: She is taking a calculus course this semester.
examples.dst: 她这学期在修微积分课程。

examples.src: The patient was diagnosed with a kidney calculus.
examples.dst: 患者被诊断出患有肾结石。

confuse.diff: calculation 指计算，calculus 指微积分
callus 指老茧，calculus 指微积分、结石

examples.src: She showed exceptional talent in mathematics.
examples.dst: 她在数学方面表现出非凡的天赋。

examples.src: Exceptional circumstances may justify a delay.
examples.dst: 特殊情况下可以允许延期。

examples.src: The students achieved exceptional results this year.
examples.dst: 今年学生们取得了优异的成绩。

confuse.diff: exceptionable 指可反对的，exceptional 指杰出的

examples.src: The passengers returned to their cabins to rest.
examples.dst: 乘客们回到各自的船舱休息。

examples.src: We spent the weekend in a log cabin by the lake.
examples.dst: 我们在湖边的一间小木屋里度过了周末。

examples.src: The flight attendant walked through the cabin to check seat belts.
examples.dst: 空乘人员走过机舱检查安全带。

confuse.diff: cabin 指船舱、小屋；cabinet 指柜子或内阁。

examples.src: I can't get a signal on my phone here.
examples.dst: 我在这儿手机没有信号。

examples.src: The driver signaled to turn left.
examples.dst: 司机打信号要向左转。

examples.src: The red light is a signal to stop.
examples.dst: 红灯是停车的信号。

confuse.diff: signal 意为信号；single 意为单一的、单身的。

examples.src: The study examined the prevalence of obesity among children.
examples.dst: 这项研究考察了儿童肥胖的流行程度。

examples.src: The prevalence of smartphones has changed daily life.
examples.dst: 智能手机的普及改变了日常生活。

examples.src: Doctors are concerned about the rising prevalence of diabetes.
examples.dst: 医生们对糖尿病患病率上升感到担忧。

confuse.diff: prevalent 是形容词,指普遍的
prevention 指预防

examples.src: There is a strange object in the sky.
examples.dst: 天空中有一个奇怪的物体。

examples.src: The object of the game is to score goals.
examples.dst: 这个游戏的目标是进球得分。

examples.src: Some students objected to the new rule.
examples.dst: 一些学生反对这条新规定。

confuse.diff: object 是物体或宾语,subject 是主题、科目或主语

examples.src: It was an apt description of the situation.
examples.dst: 这是对形势的贴切描述。

examples.src: Children are apt to copy what they see.
examples.dst: 孩子们容易模仿所见到的东西。

examples.src: She gave an apt reply to the question.
examples.dst: 她对这个问题给出了恰当的回答。

confuse.diff: adept 指熟练的，apt 指恰当的或有倾向的

examples.src: We had grilled sardines for dinner.
examples.dst: 我们晚饭吃了烤沙丁鱼。

examples.src: The passengers were packed like sardines in the bus.
examples.dst: 公共汽车上的乘客挤得像沙丁鱼罐头。

examples.src: He opened a can of sardines.
examples.dst: 他打开了一罐沙丁鱼。

confuse.diff: sardonic 指讥讽的，sardine 指沙丁鱼

examples.src: We took a minibus to the village.
examples.dst: 我们乘小型公共汽车去了这个村子。

examples.src: The school minibus takes the children home.
examples.dst: 学校的小巴送孩子们回家。

examples.src: A minibus can carry about ten people.
examples.dst: 一辆小巴可以载大约十个人。

examples.src: Many students compete for the prize.
examples.dst: 许多学生争夺这个奖项。

examples.src: He competed in the 100-meter race.
examples.dst: 他参加了百米赛跑。

examples.src: The two teams compete every year.
examples.dst: 这两支队伍每年都要比赛。

confuse.diff: compete 是竞争；complete 是完成。

examples.src: Herds of buffalo once roamed the prairie.
examples.dst: 野牛群曾在大草原上游荡。

examples.src: The settlers built a small house on the prairie.
examples.dst: 拓荒者在草原上建了一间小屋。

examples.src: The prairie stretches for miles in every direction.
examples.dst: 草原向四面八方绵延数英里。

confuse.diff: pastry 指糕点，prairie 指大草原

examples.src: He is a frequent visitor to our school.
examples.dst: 他是我们学校的常客。

examples.src: Rain is frequent in spring here.
examples.dst: 这里春天经常下雨。

examples.src: Students often frequent the library before exams.
examples.dst: 考试前学生们常去图书馆。

confuse.diff: frequent 指频繁的；fragrant 指芳香的。

examples.src: I hurt my ankle playing football.
examples.dst: 我踢足球时伤了脚踝。

examples.src: The water came up to my ankles.
examples.dst: 水漫到了我的脚踝。

examples.src: She wore a thin chain around her ankle.
examples.dst: 她脚踝上戴着一条细链子。

confuse.diff: uncle 指叔叔舅舅，ankle 指脚踝

examples.src: The factory produces garments for export.
examples.dst: 这家工厂生产出口的服装。

examples.src: She washed the delicate garment by hand.
examples.dst: 她手洗了这件精致的衣服。

examples.src: Cotton garments are comfortable in summer.
examples.dst: 棉质衣服在夏天穿着很舒服。

confuse.diff: garage指车库,garment指衣服

examples.src: Washing your hands kills bacteria.
examples.dst: 洗手可以杀死细菌。

examples.src: Some bacteria are helpful to the human body.
examples.dst: 有些细菌对人体有益。

examples.src: Bacteria grow quickly in warm places.
examples.dst: 细菌在温暖的地方繁殖很快。

confuse.diff: virus 指病毒，比细菌更小，不能独立繁殖

examples.src: The boat pulled up alongside the pier.
examples.dst: 小船靠到了码头边。

examples.src: She worked alongside experts from many countries.
examples.dst: 她与来自许多国家的专家一起工作。

examples.src: Traditional methods are used alongside modern technology.
examples.dst: 传统方法与现代技术并用。

confuse.diff: alongside 强调并排；along 表示沿着。
